5 /**
6  * Parses the .gitignore file inside the project directory and returns
7  * an array of pattern strings. Includes default folders like .git and node_modules.
8  */
9 export function getGitignorePatterns(projectDir) {
10   const patterns = ['.git/', 'node_modules/', '.foreman/'];
11   if (projectDir === null || projectDir === undefined || typeof projectDir !== 'string') {
12     return patterns;
13   }
14   const gitignorePath = path.join(projectDir, '.gitignore');
15   if (fs.existsSync(gitignorePath)) {
16     try {
17       const content = fs.readFileSync(gitignorePath, 'utf8');
18       const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
19       for (let line of lines) {
20         line = line.trim();
21         if (line && !line.startsWith('#')) {
22           patterns.push(line);
23         }
24       }
25     } catch {
26       // Ignore reading errors to remain robust
27     }
28   }
29   return patterns;
30 }
31 
32 /**
33  * Checks if a relative path matches any pattern in gitignore.
34  */
35 export function isIgnored(relPath, patterns, isDir = false) {
36   const pathStr = relPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
37   for (let pattern of patterns) {
38     let pat = pattern.replace(/\\/g, '/');
39     const matchesDirOnly = pat.endsWith('/');
40     if (matchesDirOnly && !isDir) {
41       pat = pat.slice(0, -1);
42     }
43     if (pat.endsWith('/')) {
44       pat = pat.slice(0, -1);
45     }
46     
47     const isAnchored = pat.startsWith('/');
48     const cleanPat = isAnchored ? pat.slice(1) : pat;
49     
50     // Convert glob pattern to regular expression
51     let regexStr = cleanPat
52       .replace(/[-[\]{}()+\^$|#\s]/g, '\\$&')
53       .replace(/\./g, '\\.')
54       .replace(/\*/g, '.*')
55       .replace(/\?/g, '.');
56        
57     const regex = new RegExp(isAnchored ? `^${regexStr}(?:/|$)` : `(?:^|/)${regexStr}(?:/|$)`);
58     if (regex.test(pathStr)) {
59       return true;
60     }
61   }
62   return false;
63 }

65 /**
66  * Recursively scans a directory (respecting standard ignores)
67  * and returns the total bytes and the token count heuristic (bytes / 4).
68  */
69 export function scanDirectory(projectDir) {
70   const patterns = getGitignorePatterns(projectDir);
71   let totalBytes = 0;
72 
73   function traverse(currentDir) {
74     let files;
75     try {
76       files = fs.readdirSync(currentDir);
77     } catch {
78       return; // Skip unreadable directories
79     }
80 
81     for (const file of files) {
82       const fullPath = path.join(currentDir, file);
83       const relPath = path.relative(projectDir, fullPath);
84       
85       let stat;
86       try {
87         stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
88       } catch {
89         continue; // Skip if stat fails (e.g. broken symlink)
90       }
91 
92       if (stat.isDirectory()) {
93         if (isIgnored(relPath, patterns, true)) {
94           continue;
95         }
96         traverse(fullPath);
97       } else if (stat.isFile()) {
98         if (isIgnored(relPath, patterns, false)) {
99           continue;
100         }
101         totalBytes += stat.size;
102       }
103     }
104   }
105 
106   traverse(projectDir);
107   return {
108     totalBytes,
109     tokens: Math.ceil(totalBytes / 4),
110   };
111 }

113 /**
114  * Sums the byte size of an in-memory payload (the ARTIFACT under analysis), without
115  * scanning the whole working directory. Supports the same payload shapes the map-reduce
116  * runtime uses: an array of strings/objects, or an object dictionary.
117  */
118 export function sizePayloadBytes(payload) {
119   let totalBytes = 0;
120   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
121     for (const item of payload) {
122       if (typeof item === 'string') {
123         totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(item);
124       } else if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
125         if (item.content !== undefined) {
126           totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(String(item.content || ''));
127         } else if (item.path) {
128           totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(String(item.path));
129         }
130       }
131     }
132   } else if (typeof payload === 'string') {
133     totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(payload);
134   } else if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
135     for (const val of Object.values(payload)) {
136       totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(String(val || ''));
137     }
138   }
139   return totalBytes;
140 }

142 /**
143  * Runs the router logic: computes a heuristic token count for the ARTIFACT under analysis
144  * and overrides the configured model env variables only if THAT artifact exceeds
145  * ANCHOR_FRONTIER_MAX.
146  *
147  * Sizing precedence (the artifact, never the whole cwd, unless nothing else is given):
148  *   1. `tokens`   — an explicit token estimate of the artifact (preferred).
149  *   2. `payload`  — an in-memory payload whose bytes are summed (bytes / 4 ≈ tokens).
150  *   3. `projectDir` — LEGACY fallback: scan the directory. Only used when neither a token
151  *                     estimate nor a payload is supplied. A focused, scoped question should
152  *                     pass `tokens`/`payload` so it never trips a whole-repo model override.
153  */
154 export function runRouter({ projectDir, payload = null, tokens = null, env = process.env, overrideMax = null } = {}) {
155   let tokenHeuristic;
156   let totalBytes;
157   if (typeof tokens === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(tokens)) {
158     tokenHeuristic = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(tokens));
159     totalBytes = tokenHeuristic * 4;
160   } else if (payload !== null && payload !== undefined) {
161     totalBytes = sizePayloadBytes(payload);
162     tokenHeuristic = Math.ceil(totalBytes / 4);
163   } else {
164     const sizerResult = scanDirectory(projectDir);
165     tokenHeuristic = sizerResult.tokens;
166     totalBytes = sizerResult.totalBytes;
167   }
168 
169   let frontierMax = 100000;
170   if (env.ANCHOR_FRONTIER_MAX) {
171     const val = parseInt(env.ANCHOR_FRONTIER_MAX, 10);
172     if (!isNaN(val)) frontierMax = val;
173   }
174   if (overrideMax !== null && overrideMax !== undefined) {
175     frontierMax = overrideMax;
176   }
177   
178   // W4 (2026-07-05): model ids are agy LABELS resolved via the TRIO_TIER ladder — NEVER a hardcoded
179   // API-style id (the old hardcoded API-style defaults were PHANTOM ids that live agy does not
180   // recognize and silently degrades to Flash). A big artifact that exceeds the frontier ceiling is
181   // routed to the high-context, cheaper STANDARD label; a small artifact to the frontier HEAVY label.
182   const highContextModel = env.GANDALF_HIGH_CONTEXT_MODEL || env.GEMINI_HIGH_CONTEXT_MODEL
183     || resolveGeminiModel({ env: { ...env, TRIO_TIER: 'standard' } });
184   const frontierModel = env.GANDALF_FRONTIER_MODEL || env.GEMINI_MODEL
185     || resolveGeminiModel({ env: { ...env, TRIO_TIER: 'heavy' } });
186   
187   let selectedModel;
188   let overridden = false;
189   if (tokenHeuristic > frontierMax) {
190     selectedModel = highContextModel;
191     overridden = true;
192   } else {
193     selectedModel = frontierModel;
194   }
195   
196   // Apply overrides to the provided env object
197   env.GEMINI_MODEL = selectedModel;
198   env.TRIO_MODEL = selectedModel;
199   env.GANDALF_ROUTED_MODEL = selectedModel;
200   
201   return {
202     tokenHeuristic,
203     frontierMax,
204     selectedModel,
205     overridden,
206     totalBytes
207   };
208 }
